features: workspace default features; no extra feature flags
scope: All Cargo workspace packages; no user-specified coverage exclusions; cargo-llvm-cov default filename filters. Test files are filtered by the tool, while server-provider and server-terminal test_support.rs helpers remain in the totals. Existing ignored credential/paid-provider/external-worker tests remain ignored. Doctests are executed by cargo test but not instrumented. Linux and Windows not executed.
commands: cargo test --offline -p server-api -p server-bin -p server-browser -p server-domain -p server-filesystem -p server-metadata -p server-model -p server-protocol -p server-provider -p server-schedule -p server-terminal -p server-voice --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=1

baseline.comparison: Historical measurement, not rerun this task. Its five recorded production hashes match baseline HEAD; intervening changes to Cargo/crates/bins production are those same recorded files. Same platform, default features and source scope; historical retries are documented in the baseline artifact.

sourceFingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted relative path UTF-8 + NUL + raw file bytes + NUL; includes root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/rustfmt.toml and .rs/.py/.json/.txt/.sh/.toml files under crates and bins

diffObserver.reproduction: An exact instrumented retry passed once; the next diagnostic retry failed after 5.66 seconds while waiting for the second observer update after the first edit. Existing five-second receive limit was not increased.
diffObserver.fix: Dedicated one-permit background checkout lane with FIFO semaphore waits; cancellable pending admission and cancellation check after tracked blocking completion. Foreground admission retains its separate budget.
diffObserver.deterministicCases: Five filesystem polling tests use manually polled futures and gated blocking reads; one model test verifies foreground admission while the polling lane is occupied. Old try_acquire would return Ready(None) at the waiting assertion; this counterfactual was reviewed, not separately compiled.

server.note: Each manifest test function name is checked against a passed test path in the final execution log; table-driven cases are not counted separately.

workspaceInstrumented.note: Each manifest test function name is checked against a passed test path in the final execution log; table-driven cases are not counted separately.

notCovered: Directory RPC pagination/sorting/error branches, project icon GIF/JPEG/SVG parsing and discovery branches, Forge nested check/timeline/error projections, and conflicting Git pull cleanup need more targeted fixtures.

Real authenticated Codex model turns, protocol changes and disconnect/recovery after native acceptance or approval are not live-validated. Paid DeepSeek requests and external-worker checks are existing ignored tests.
Paseo projected checkpoint validation and tool lifecycle compaction in fork-context remain different from raw-row Rust export.
Native streaming STT, real browser extension/browser-tool injection and native notification delivery are outside these offline fixtures.
Dangling symlinks whose outside targets do not exist retain the pre-existing lexical fallback behavior.
Actual pipe read boundaries may coalesce bytewise writes; the UTF-8 transport fixture does not deterministically force every read boundary.
Linux/Windows process and PTY behavior; filesystem and locking behavior on those platforms.
